stem.text: A stone is released from rest and falls a long distance in air.
Which graph could show the variation with time $t$ of the acceleration $a$ of the stone?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, showing a curve rising from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, showing a straight line.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, showing a horizontal line.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis a and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, showing a curve falling from the vertical axis.
